title: 矽光子熱光相移器
summary: 以熱光相位、熱阻／熱容與多通道串擾為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Thermo-optic phase, thermal resistance/capacitance and crosstalk, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

steps.title: 定義加熱與光學區：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Define heater and optical regions: model and design
steps.objective: 建立定義加熱與光學區的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define heater and optical regions.
steps.instruction: 先標出「定義加熱與光學區」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。加熱器位置決定熱流路徑，金屬靠近波導也可能增加光吸收。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for define heater and optical regions. Heater placement sets heat-flow paths, while metal near a guide can increase optical absorption. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 在截面同時標電流、熱流和光模態。
steps.observationEn: Mark current, heat flow and optical mode on one cross-section.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「加熱器越靠近光芯只有好處」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Moving a heater closer to the optical core has only benefits" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設均勻有效熱光係數 dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、L=1 mm、λ=1.55 μm，ΔTπ=λ/(2L·dn_eff/dT)=4.306 K。若集總 R_th=200 K/W，Pπ=21.53 mW；再假設 C_th=10 μJ/K，τ=R_thC_th=2.00 ms。 係數是有效模態係數而非純材料值，溫度視為均勻；R_th、C_th 為同一集總熱節點，真實結構可能有多個時間常數及溫度相依電阻。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical uniform effective dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, L=1 mm and λ=1.55 μm, ΔTπ=4.306 K. A lumped R_th=200 K/W gives Pπ=21.53 mW; assumed C_th=10 μJ/K gives τ=2.00 ms. The coefficient is modal rather than purely material and temperature is uniform. R_th/C_th describe one lumped thermal node; real structures can have multiple time constants and temperature-dependent resistance.
